name: Intel Arc B570 Graphics - official specifications (Intel ARK)
notes: ARK memory table: 10 GB GDDR6, 160-bit interface, 19 Gbps, 380 GB/s. Confirms the cut-down B570 is NOT the B580 (12 GB / 192-bit / 456 GB/s) - the earlier record's null was correct and the B580 figures must not be copied across.
